newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-UNHAPPY BONNISSEL HOPES FOR MOVE TO ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNHAPPY BONNISSEL HOPES FOR MOVE TO ARSENAL.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna defender Jerome Bonnissel, a rare case of a French player unhappy with his transfer abroad, is hoping to join compatriot Arsene Wenger at Arsenal.

"What I like about Arsenal is to work with Arsene Wenger. I know how he works and I know above all that he's interested in Jerome Bonnissel, whereas La Coruna simply wanted to recruit a full back," the France under-21 international said.

Bonnissel, who moved to Spain from Montpellier five months ago, lost his place through injury after the opening league match of the season against Real Madrid and is unhappy at the club where compatriots Corentin Martins and Mickael Madar shine.
"There's isn't a good sporting climate and I don't have the trainer's trust," said Bonnissel.
